free_tier_limits: 1,000,000 requests per month with no velocity throttling. Free use is non-commercial and limited to historical holidays; API data may be stored offline for no more than 24 hours.
rate_limits: 1,000,000 requests per month on every plan, resetting on the first day of each month at 00:00 UTC. No additional velocity limit is imposed; exceeding the monthly allowance returns HTTP 429.
description: HolidayAPI provides API-key-authenticated REST access to public holidays and observances for 250 countries. Holiday queries use country and year, with documented filters including month, day, public, subdivisions, search, language, previous, and upcoming; there is no observed-date request filter. Paid plans permit commercial use and years 1–2050+, while the States & Provinces plan adds subdivision data. All plans advertise the same monthly request allowance.
